landing.title: ECloe Pay
landing.lede: A runnable wallet demo for secure simulated payments, eligible benefits, and reward-event evidence without creating users or processing real money.
landing.safeCopy: ECloe Pay validates a deterministic confirmation step, locks duplicate payment attempts with idempotency, and records only synthetic evidence.
landing.storageCopy: Demo receipts and Pay evidence use a dedicated private Azure Blob container:
landing.schemaCopy: Simulated sessions, payment orders, benefit interactions, and outbox rows belong to the dedicated
landing.step2: Review a simulated wallet and eligible benefit.
landing.step3: Accept terms and simulate the payment confirmation.
landing.step4: Inspect reward-event evidence without real funds.
landing.noFinancialService: No real financial service is provided
landing.disclaimerCopy: ECloe Pay does not create real users, process real money, move funds, authorize payments, approve credit, perform fraud checks, open accounts, or provide regulated payment services.

login.title: ECloe Pay - Demo login
login.heading: Sign in with the demo persona
login.badge: Demo identity - no real bank account
login.copy: The demo account validation happens in Azure SQL. The entry form does not show ready-made credentials and does not create a real account, move money, or collect real personal or banking data.

wallet.title: ECloe Pay - Demo wallet
wallet.assistantCopy: Your assistant is online and ready to help.
wallet.presentationMode: Presentation mode - data is not being persisted.
wallet.noRealValue: No real value is stored or moved.
wallet.benefitMessage: Keep essential spending on track with more control and peace of mind.
wallet.securityHint: Accepted only with the deterministic demo code and idempotency key.
wallet.securityHero: The demo keeps synthetic payment state and blocks duplicate confirmations.
wallet.checkCookie: HttpOnly session cookie and CSRF token validation
wallet.checkCode: Deterministic code for the demo payment order
wallet.checkFields: No card, bank, CPF, or account fields
wallet.securityBaselineCopy: ECloe Pay validates the simulated confirmation, locks the session, uses idempotency, separates Pay state in Azure SQL, and never asks for real payment credentials.
wallet.termsCopy1: ECloe Pay is a demonstration application. It does not create real users, process real money, move funds, authorize payments, approve credit, perform fraud checks, or provide regulated financial services.
wallet.termsCopy2: All balances, transactions, benefits, rewards, and confirmations are synthetic and session-scoped. Do not enter real card, bank, CPF, password, or account information.
wallet.termsCheck: I understand this is a demo and no real money is processed.
